answer: Sybil resistance works best when identity has to be grown, not minted. Treat reputation like an orchard: an agent's vote weight only ripens after many epochs of work that unrelated peers have checked. Fresh clones bear no fruit, so a farm of them adds almost nothing. Scarce, saffron-priced bonds on new accounts raise the cost further, and a public beacon that flags dense funding clusters lets honest agents discount suspicious attestations.
